digest.component_or_area: store git operations and local concurrency handling
propositions: Local git call sites contend on shared locks (index.lock, ref locks) under high concurrent local use; errors surface to agents instead of being transparently handled

Git's own lock retry semantics apply only to ref locks with configurable timeouts (core.filesRefLockTimeout, core.packedRefsTimeout), but deliberately not to index.lock, requiring rebar to implement retry at the seam

Per-store advisory flock plus bounded jittered retry on git's lock signatures (index.lock, ref/config locks) with silent recovery for transients and one actionable error on budget exhaustion achieves automatic contention absorption without escalation

All local-only git call sites must be bounded with watchdog timeouts (120s for run_git_write covering txn/compact/delete; 120s for fsck read sites; 300s for metrics blame/git_metrics) to prevent hung mounts from stalling the entire fleet via held store locks
